reviewer: Codex visual inspection of rendered original PDF pages
scope: Four targeted counterexamples, not a full-corpus accuracy benchmark or engineering approval

samples.source_path: 示例规范/GB 50223-2008 建筑工程抗震设防分类标准.pdf
samples.expected_text: 为明确建筑工程抗震设计的设防类别和相应的抗震设防标准，以有效地减轻地震灾害，制定本标准。
samples.observation: The PDF has four separate clauses; the legacy selected native text and splitter merge subsequent clauses into 1.0.1.

samples.source_path: 示例规范/GB 50367-2013 混凝土结构加固设计规范.pdf
samples.expected_body_start: 混凝土结构的加固设计使用年限，应按下列原则确定
samples.observation: OCR puts 3.1.7 on its own line; the legacy splitter appends its body to 3.1.6. Only the start page was visually reviewed.

samples.source_path: 示例规范/GB 50098-2009 人民防空工程设计防火规范.pdf
samples.table_title: 采光窗井与相邻地面建筑的最小防火间距
samples.observation: OCR has flattened numbers without cell geometry; the legacy database has no structured tables for this PDF. These cells are review fixtures, not standalone design advice.
